svg.title: One Conditional Access policy for a test group
svg.desc: Part 3 of the lab: the group TestUsers is included in the policy. The group EmergencyAccess and your admin account are excluded, and exclude wins. The policy reads like an if-then rule. If the user is in TestUsers and opens Azure Virtual Desktop or Windows Cloud Login, then require multifactor authentication. The policy state goes Report-only, On, Off, then Delete. Part 4: the What If tool simulates a sign-in against the policy. Part 5: the policy writes its report-only result to the sign-in log. Never use All users or All resources.
svg.text: Excluded. The admin you work from
If the user is in TestUsers
State, in this order (On = test group only):
Signing in to the AVD service
Signing in to the VM itself
Before this: licence assigned, security defaults off, emergency sign-in tested.
